packaged_sample_rule: first/middle/last in every split/author/label-pattern group, plus longest unselected messages until 200
label_policy: prompts/codex-train-dataset-prompt.md six message-only signals; no deal-history inference

boundary_decisions.text: Would 10:15 on Wednesday work for you if the team can accommodate it?
boundary_decisions.reason: A possible Wednesday time is offered conditionally; no booking is asserted.

boundary_decisions.text: Your appointment is entered for Thursday at 12:45.
boundary_decisions.reason: The appointment is entered as an existing arrangement; booking is asserted without requiring deal history.

boundary_decisions.text: It hasn't been bought. You can still enquire about purchasing it.
boundary_decisions.reason: The definite reference to the offered item being unbought and purchasable is an availability claim.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

The silver Camry quote would be $506 a month. Staff haven't verified that the specific vehicle remains available, so please wait for their stock answer.

Northgate Motors
boundary_decisions.reason: Quotes an amount but explicitly leaves inventory unverified; price true, availability false.

boundary_decisions.text: You've had the paperwork for 3 days. Stop dithering and decide.
boundary_decisions.reason: Pressure tied to a document-reading delay is unprofessional; three days is not a financial amount.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

The licence instructions are attached yet again. Stop expecting everyone to compensate for you not reading a simple message.

Northgate Motors
boundary_decisions.reason: Dismissive licence instructions are off-tone; no booking, inventory or price claim.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

Your Monday appointment about the white CX-5 is confirmed. The proposed total would be $30,650; a current stock answer is still needed.

Northgate Motors
boundary_decisions.reason: A confirmed meeting and proposed amount do not make the explicitly unverified vehicle available.

boundary_decisions.text: The one you saved is still on our lot for sale. Decide today or stop messaging us.
boundary_decisions.reason: Still on sale asserts stock, while the demand to decide or stop messaging adds pressure.

boundary_decisions.text: Does the screen support Android Auto without a cable?
boundary_decisions.reason: An equipment compatibility question is neither financial nor a request for human contact.

boundary_decisions.text: Could you send a photograph with the steering wheel pulled all the way out?
boundary_decisions.reason: Requests a steering-column photograph, not money or a human handoff.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

Could the manager send me a direct email about the access arrangements? I would like somebody at the store to take over this conversation.

Kamal
boundary_decisions.reason: Explicitly asks the manager to contact the buyer about access: human only.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

Can you itemise the required and optional charges on the silver Lancer? I want the full tax-inclusive figure.

Saif
boundary_decisions.reason: Requests itemised financial charges; asking the assistant to send information alone is not an explicit human request.

boundary_decisions.text: The offer arrived while I was driving. Could Dana call later and go through the total with me?
boundary_decisions.reason: A named-person callback to discuss a quote requests both human contact and financial information.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

The grey RAV4's advert is older than the latest staff update. We need a current stock answer before saying that specific vehicle is here.

Northgate Motors
boundary_decisions.reason: Needs a fresh inventory answer before saying the car is here; no guarantee.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hi Zara,

I've finished arranging your showroom visit after the school run. The booking is confirmed, and the document-format request is attached to the enquiry.

Northgate Motors
boundary_decisions.reason: Booking complete for after the school run is a booking claim without a clock time.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hi Mara,

The white Outback you selected is available at this store. Nobody has bought it, and staff have your request for a loading-area photograph.

Northgate Motors
boundary_decisions.reason: The car is explicitly unsold; passing an unrelated question to staff does not cancel the claim.

boundary_decisions.text: Your orange Crosstrek meeting is arranged. Its status is unverified, and we don't owe you an instant stock answer.
boundary_decisions.reason: Meeting is arranged while stock remains unverified; pestering accusation adds bad tone.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

The lease would be $271 biweekly. Quote response 119 is final; the customer's personal circumstances are not accepted as further input.

Northgate Motors
boundary_decisions.reason: A monetary lease quote plus bureaucratic rejection of personal circumstances expresses price and bad tone.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

The cream Golf link is correct. I just wanted to confirm that you received it, and I haven't chosen a day to visit yet.

Yara
boundary_decisions.reason: Acknowledges receipt and says no visit day has been chosen; neither buyer signal.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

I don't need another quote. I do need a human to contact me about the surname correction on the application.

Omar
boundary_decisions.reason: Declines another quote but requests a human about a surname: human only.

boundary_decisions.text:
Hello,

Can you send the purple Note's deposit amount and refund conditions? I need to know how much would be returned if I cancelled.

Jamil
boundary_decisions.reason: Asks deposit/refund figures, not a specific human channel.

boundary_decisions.text: The calculator uses the wrong term. Please have Dana call with a corrected payment.
boundary_decisions.reason: The calculator complaint is accompanied by a named-person callback request for a corrected payment: both signals.

boundary_decisions.text: The payment you sent is more than I can manage.
boundary_decisions.reason: Unaffordable payment is a remark, with no requested revised price.

boundary_decisions.text: I talked to Dana yesterday and she answered my question.
boundary_decisions.reason: Past completed staff contact is not a new human-contact request.

boundary_decisions.text: Please stop sending me messages.
boundary_decisions.reason: Opt-out alone has neither buyer label; ignored_opt_out needs later event history.

boundary_decisions.text: How much room is there behind the third row?
boundary_decisions.reason: Physical room is not financial how much.

construction_revisions: A near-copy of a frozen test sentence was rewritten in train, not test.
An ownership-only availability statement was made explicitly for-sale to remove ambiguity.
Two awkward phrases in buyer contact requests were rewritten.

Model references were reduced among availability positives. Limited literal keyword probes have positive-negative gaps below 15 points; a stricter capitalisation-sensitive diagnostic retains a 16.5-point train availability gap. This is a residual nuisance-vocabulary difference, not a claim of perfect lexical balance.
Dev multi-signal messages were rewritten to remove repeated vehicle/amount anchors.
One sixfold repeated sentence was rewritten so full sentences of four or more words occur at most five times.
limits: The authoring assistant reviewed its own data; this is not independent human agreement.
No numeric label-accuracy percentage is claimed.
Balanced synthetic composition is not a measured production distribution.
Hard/easy difficulty remains unassigned; do not backfill it using model errors.
